title: Mental Mathematics: Adding and Subtracting in Your Head
seo_title: Grade 3 Mental Maths Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Mental mathematics: number bonds to 20; addition and subtraction facts to 20; add or subtract multiples of 10 and 100 to or from any number up to 1 000; doubling and halving; use the relationship between addition and subtraction.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 3 maths worksheets: mental maths, adding and subtracting ones, tens and hundreds, doubles and missing numbers. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Adding ones changes the ones digit (and sometimes the tens).
  • Adding tens changes the tens digit; adding hundreds changes the hundreds digit.
  • Use bonds: 7 + 3 = 10, so 70 + 30 = 100.
  • Double the tens and the ones: double 34 = 60 + 8 = 68.

Examples

Example

458 + 30

5 tens + 3 tens = 8 tens

Answer: 488

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The wrong digit+ 30 changes the tens.
Crossing a hundred380 + 40 = 420.
Doubling one digitDouble both digits.

faq.a: Quick facts make bigger sums easier.

items.e: There are 7 + 6 = 13 cubes. Exchange 10 cubes for 1 rod: 4 tens become 5 tens, and 3 ones are left. 147 + 6 = 153.

items.q: You add 400 to 238. Which digit changes?
items.e: 400 is 4 hundreds, so only the hundreds digit changes: 238 + 400 = 638.

items.q: You take away 20 from 465. Which digit changes?
items.e: 20 is 2 tens, and 465 has 6 tens. Only the tens digit changes: 465 − 20 = 445.

To work out 38 + 7, you jump to 40 first. How do you split the 7?
items.e: 38 needs 2 to make 40. Then 5 more: 40 + 5 = 45. So split 7 into 2 and 5.

items.q: To work out 64 − 9, you jump back to 60 first. How do you split the 9?
items.e: 64 − 4 = 60. Then 5 more: 60 − 5 = 55. So split 9 into 4 and 5.

items.q: Jump the tens, then the ones. What is 45 + 32?
items.e: 45 + 30 = 75. Then 75 + 2 = 77. (75 stops after the tens.)

items.q: Jump back the tens, then the ones. What is 86 − 43?
items.e: 86 − 40 = 46. Then 46 − 3 = 43. (46 stops after the tens.)
